text:
The repaired packet is a proposed B05–B07 image design. It closes the prior high tag12 gap. No new high contradiction and no false execution, vector, authentication, or gate-closure claim appears in the embedded bytes. Four medium defects remain.

## Evidence limits

This reading uses only the embedded packet. Manifest SHA-256 values were not recomputed. `history/pre-grok-repair-01` bytes are not in the packet, so the byte-for-byte preservation sentence is an author statement. The RESULT sentences about the development skill, guarded status, and absent AGENTS routing paths cite material that is not embedded. No encoder output, digest vector, test log, verifier transcript, or vote is present to review.

## Prior high tag12 gap

The prior high defect is repaired in the embedded SPEC text.

At tag12 the consumer compares the authenticated policy body to already anchored facts in wire-anchor order, and only then compares `wire.policyHash` to the computed purpose4 digest:

1. `wireProfile` to the retained V-S0-01 selection (tag1)
2. `domain` to tag2
3. `agreementInstanceId` to tag3/B01
4. `actionId` to tag6/B04
5. `sourceVersion` to tag7
6. `sourceHash` to tag8’s computed B05 digest
7. `coreVersion` to tag9
8. `coreProgramId` to tag10/B04 and the lowered `programId`
9. `coreHash` to tag11’s computed B06 digest

A genuine body mismatch is `BindingRejected/W_D2F_FIELD_MISMATCH` at anchor12, `field=policy.<name>`, `inputPath=policy.<name>`, `sourcePath=null`. Provider failure stays `EVIDENCE_INVALID` or `BINDING_UNAVAILABLE` before any body comparison. H-H11, H-H19, and H-H20 match that order. Asset, scale, signer, keyRef, validity, caps, failure, empty constructors, and operation terms stay on later tags. That matches the embedded W-D2F rule that already processed facts are compared at the current anchor and future signed fields wait for their own tags.

## What holds

Non-self-reference holds for the recommended path. Purpose1 omits both claim leaves. Purpose4 embeds the computed purpose1 and purpose3 digests and omits its own digest. Neither image includes `policyHash`, `authorizationDigest`, or a signature. Strategy A replaces the whole grammar-located `source_hash` and `digest` tokens. The stated marker lengths are 24 and 19 bytes with the quote characters included, and the stated maximum projection is 65536−3−3+24+19 = 65573. A is a preimage alternative with no consumer, no policy link, and no fallback.

The envelope is `ASCII("moriarty-mil4-image/1") || 0x00 || purpose:u8 || payloadLength:u32be || payload`, then SHA-256. Purposes are only `01`, `02`, `03`, and `04`. The prefix does not redefine wire/3’s content digest or select a B09 signature message.

The purpose3 closure matches the embedded modules. `financial-agreement-source-v6-frontend.ts` imports only `mil4-s0-core-v5.ts`. `mil4-s0-core-v5.ts` has no imports. `mil4-s0-source-v6.ts` imports those two. The required exports `parseAndLowerSource6`, `prepareMil4S0`, and `prepareSource6S0Unqualified` are present. Raw file bytes are the commitment. The text states that equal source bytes do not prove execution, that a runtime, compiler, or native backend needs separate loaded-artifact evidence, and that this package contains no B16 history adapter. H-H07, H-H24, and H-H25 say the same thing. PLAN’s C handoff still forbids `lowered.state` and `prepareSource6S0Unqualified`.

Agreement remains `ast.programId`. The selected builtin remains `ast.selected.actionId`, copied to `Core.intent.programId`. The embedded lowerer does that. The two permitted pairs remain `(TransferLiteralFee, 01)` and `(RepayAccrualFirst, 02)`.

Oracle inventory matches the RESULT count: H-P01 and H-P02, presentation oracle H-P03, and 28 H-H rows (H-H01–H-H13, H-H14A/B/C, H-H15–H-H26). They are written as predicates. W-D2E `actionId=Action` fixtures stay historical. F-S0-01 stays the closed success mapping. Debtor, creditor, and `keyScheme` stay outside the policy and on tag35/B11 and tag14/B09. The embedded wrapper still returns stage failures first and withholds a candidate when `signed_action` and `submit` differ; the hash text keeps that behavior off the W-D2F schedule.

## Medium defects

1. Tag8’s source-image identity check is still incomplete. The tag8 paragraph says to compare the current `sourceHash` with the computed digest, and then says domain, agreement, and action must agree with the bound context. It gives no comparison order, no `field`/`inputPath`, and no rule that a body mismatch wins before hash equality. Tag11 states label and `coreProgramId` checks before `coreHash`. Tag12 states body-before-hash. A substituted definition whose claim was updated to the new purpose1 digest is exactly the case the tag12 repair treats as `policy.<field>` rather than as a hash mismatch. Tag8 does not yet have that diagnostic.

2. Suite selection contains a contradictory sentence. The same SPEC section says an authenticated profile/view selects the suite, ambiguous suites reject, and A cannot be a fallback. H-H17 says no alternate-suite retry. The same section also says “Never try purposes 1 and 2 until one hash matches.” That sentence reads as a search over purpose `01` and purpose `02`. Those two instructions cannot be implemented together.

3. H-H21 orders a B14 result that the embedded W-D2F schedule does not name. The oracle distinguishes missing or invalid B14 evidence, a “prior grant-scope” mismatch, a retained `policy.grossCap` mismatch, and a false gross-cap authority predicate. Embedded B14 has provider authentication and one adopted authority relation. The hash text calls this a bounded refinement of the per-tag schedule, and the direct-literal-before-policy-before-predicate order is stated, including the tag24/tag25 rule not to re-authenticate B14. The “prior grant-scope” winner still has no field, code, `factPath`, or `sourcePath`. H-H22’s payer-before-debtor and debtor-before-amount order is specified; this B14 class is not.

4. A Source-accepted control in `keyRef` has no scheduled rejection family. The embedded parser accepts a decoded U+0000, U+001F, or U+007F through `JSON.parse`. Core `opaque` rejects those characters later. Purpose4 also rejects them, and H-H23 forbids inventing a `SOURCE6` error. The same design says image-parser codes are not defined and are not borrowed from the wire decoder. After a successful B07 provenance check, a structurally authentic policy whose `keyRef` fails the opaque or shortest-UTF-8 rule has no assigned result among `EVIDENCE_INVALID`, `FIELD_MISMATCH`, and format rejection, and no position relative to the nine body comparisons.

## Execution and gate status

Embedded SPEC, DECISION-MATRIX, and RESULT agree on the current status. The image suite is proposed and unadopted. Encoder, consumer, registry, authentication, correspondence proof, and tests are absent. Computed Source, Core, and policy digest vectors are absent. W-D2, W-D3, and B01–B17 remain open. The author’s text-consistency pass is identified as an author pass. That status matches the embedded documents.
